description: This file defines an Angular component 'SidebarComponent' responsible for the sidebar UI in the note organizer app. It handles note filtering, tag management, and emits events for note creation and filter changes.

classes.name: SidebarComponent
classes.description: An Angular component managing note filtering and UI interactions in the sidebar.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component and subscribes to the filter state from NoteService.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Handles search query changes, updates the filter, and emits filter change event.

methods.name: togglePinnedOnly
methods.description: Toggles the 'pinned only' filter and updates the note filter state.

methods.name: addTagsFromInput
methods.description: Splits input string into tags, ensures uniqueness, updates filter.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a specified tag from filter.

methods.name: changeSort
methods.description: Changes the sorting criteria for notes.

methods.name: toggleSortDir
methods.description: Toggles the sort direction between ascending and descending.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Emits an event to create a new note.
